title: Why Confronting Your Ex’s New Girlfriend NEVER Ends Well
description:
An Illinois woman had a run-in with police after banging on her alleged ex-boyfriend’s new girlfriend’s apartment and screaming obscenities. The kicker, the man claimed he had no idea who she was. Joliet police arrested Arionte Lusby on multiple charges, including disorderly conduct and resisting arrest. Lusby pleaded not guilty and is awaiting trial.
